Scientific_Justification: TRIP is direct and quantitative. TWIP is retained as a positive source-supported condition-level attribution with explicitly lower evidence grade than the 700C TEM evidence.

Condition_Level_Evidence: Initial single FCC/no HCP. Deformed EBSD shows increasing HCP; near-fracture TEM/SAED directly shows HCP martensite, deformation twins and dislocation slip.
Authors state deformation is mainly limited dislocation slip and pre-existing defects hinder TRIP-TWIP activation, but this is not explicit condition-wide absence evidence.
Scientific_Justification: Do NOT convert 'hindered' or lack of 600C post-test mechanism images into TRIP=0 or TWIP=0. Slip=1 is source-supported.
